name: store listing: creates Shieldaig Speyside 30-year-old with structured age

reference.name: Shieldaig Speyside Sin Malt 30-year-old Scotch Whisky

dbOutcome.summary: Peated now contains bottle 44266 as Shieldaig Speyside 30-year-old. The regression being protected is the earlier classifier-created draft that used the confusing display name Shieldaig Speyside while storing the 30-year age only as structured bottle metadata.

provenance.notes: Total Wine markets this as Shieldaig Speyside Sin Malt 30Yr Scotch Whisky and describes it as matured for at least 30 years. The eval simulates the pre-creation local-search state: the 30-year Bottle is absent, but a same-family Shieldaig Speyside 18-year-old Bottle exists. The agent must preserve the age in statedAge while keeping Speyside as the stable expression.

expected.summary: Create a new Shieldaig Speyside 30-year-old Bottle with Speyside as the stable expression and 30 in the structured statedAge field.
